### Lord, Send the Ravens
Author: Jennifer Dukes Lee
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-march-11-2026.html
Passage: 1 Kings 17:6
Points:
- God sustained Elijah in isolation using ravens, an unclean bird and an astonishing delivery method.
- The Lord frequently works outside conventional human expectations to care for His people.
- Divine provision is rarely predictable, but it is deeply personal and creative.
- Asking God to "send the ravens" means surrendering control and allowing Him to show up however He chooses.
- Believers are invited to wait patiently and keep their eyes open for unexpected help.

### A Step at a Time
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living Ministries
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/a-step-at-a-time1
Passage: 1 Kings 17:4
Points:
- God's direction always comes packaged with His provision.
- Hardships and disruptions often jolt us out of monotonous routines into deeper spiritual growth.
- Faith requires learning to trust God one day and one step at a time.
- Elijah was not shown the entire future; he was only told to go to the brook and trust the promise.
- God revealed the prophet's next assignment only after the brook had completely dried up.
